pane_list.name: link_list
pane_list.tool_tip: The scripts found, and the file proposed for each. Tick those to link; Return or double-click chooses a file.

check_box.label: Send files that differ
check_box.name: link_send_differing
check_box.tool_tip: Once linked, send each file that is not what its script holds in-world, keeping what the script had in History

button.label: Choose File...
button.name: link_choose
button.tool_tip: Choose the file for the chosen script: one of those found, or any on disk

button.label: Link
button.name: link_do
button.tool_tip: Link each ticked script to its file: from then on it is changed through the file, and saving the file sends it

button.label: Cancel
button.name: link_cancel
button.tool_tip: Link nothing, and close this tab
